model_output.verdict: A welder and fitter with clear structural steel and pipe experience and a strong inspection record.
write_up: Your resume points clearly toward welding and fitting work. At Maumee Steel Fabricators, you name the steel assemblies, welding processes and fit-up tolerance, then give a recruiter an inspection record tied to a real job. That makes your work easy to picture on a first pass.

The Riverfront Tower line is your model: it names the inspections, the job and about how many welds were involved. Your certifications are easy to find, and your earlier pipe work gives a recruiter another setting where you've used your welding skills.
I'd expect a recruiter to move this forward with a question about the shutdown work. Start there: say what you did during those jobs, while keeping the Riverfront Tower line intact.
